name: app-orange-balance-screen-hands-intelligent-banking-cover
title: Orange Balance Screen in Blurred Hands
whatItIs: A cover with a phone showing an orange-red gradient balance screen ($12,680.42) and stacked cards, held by hands softly blurred in front, with a two-tone headline 'Intelligent Banking, Full Control' and a year tag.
whatItMeans: The blurred foreground hands create depth and intimacy, and the hot orange screen draws the eye against white.
techniques: Foreground hands out of focus for depth of field
White fade rising from the bottom to hold headline text
Two-tone headline with the second phrase dimmed
Round logo chips and year pill at the top
Card stack peeking below the balance
bestFor: Hero images with a text zone

vocabulary.definition: Blurring near objects to focus on the main subject.
An area kept clear to place a headline.
